page.overview:
Who is Azune Nayar?

(pronounced Ah-ZOO-nay or AH-zoo-nay) Mar 2026|1:12:40}} is a paladin/sorcerer played by Luis Carazo in Campaign Four.

Azune is human in appearance. at moments they visibly glow, like a sun setting behind an ocean, and when he channels his sorcery they become even more like the scene they resemble (like an actual sun setting into water). He is just over 5'10" tall but projects the image of being taller by his proud bearing. His body is strong, lean, and muscular, with medium brown skin and auburn hair tied back in a braid. His hair can go past his mid back when out of the braid. He has a birthmark on the left side of his neck and face. He looks like his parents, although they had dark hair and more tanned skin.

His arm has a tattoo reading, "Have mercy on those I send you".

Azune stands tall and proud. He has an emotional side, especially when remembering old friends and witnessing significant moments. He values memories and past events a lot, and struggles differentiating between letting go and forgetting, preferring to suffer if that suffering honors a specific memory.
